# IMPACT

> IMPACT is a free web app and AI connector with eight positioning tools built on Shashwat Ghosh's IMPACT framework, for CMOs and marketing teams. Describe your product, buyers and rivals, and each tool returns a structured positioning draft with hypotheses to test, or a full audit. Add https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude or ChatGPT, no sign-in.

- Web app (no sign-in): https://impact.gtmhelix.com/
- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf: https://impact.gtmhelix.com/connect/
- Docs (MCP and REST, every field): https://impact.gtmhelix.com/docs/
- FAQ: https://impact.gtmhelix.com/faq/
- Privacy policy: https://impact.gtmhelix.com/privacy/
- Terms of use: https://impact.gtmhelix.com/terms/
- Local npm package: @shashwatgtmalpha/impact-mcp
- Source code: https://github.com/shashwatgtm/impact-mcp
- Built by: Shashwat Ghosh, Helix GTM Consulting (https://www.gtmexpert.com)
- All connectors and Claude plugins: https://tools.gtmhelix.com/

## Tools

- [IMPACT Framework Guide](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-get-framework/) (`impact_get_framework`): Returns the IMPACT positioning method step by step: identify champions, map alternatives, pinpoint value, anchor in a market, craft the message and translate it to execution, with a template or checklist for each step. An optional focus phase returns one step only, and your sector adds that sector's buyer roles, measures and proof points.
- [Identify Champions](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-identify-champions/) (`impact_identify_champions`): Takes what your product does and the problem it solves, and returns hypotheses for who buys it: the champion, the economic buyer, the technical influencer, commercial and control reviewers and daily users, with warning signs of an anti-champion, a path to develop the champion and what to give them. Optional company name, target company type, price point and sector fit the roles to your market. These are roles to test, not named people.
- [Map Alternatives](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-map-alternatives/) (`impact_map_alternatives`): Takes your product and its category, and returns a map of the alternatives your buyers weigh: one card for each competitor you name, the status-quo options you list and doing nothing, where you can lead, and discovery questions to learn more. Optional competitor weaknesses and your strengths fill the cards, and your sector adds its questions and objections. It uses only what you give and says what would sharpen the map.
- [Pinpoint Value](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-pinpoint-value/) (`impact_pinpoint_value`): Takes your target customer, the main outcome they get and what you do that others do not, and returns value proposition statements in three versions, a value matrix for your own figures, proof points ranked from customer results to social proof, versions for different audiences and channels, and questions to test the value. Optional product name, category, customer results and business model shape it.
- [Anchor Market](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-anchor-market/) (`impact_anchor_market`): Takes what your product does and the segments you are weighing, and returns a beachhead market choice: your segments ranked from your own customers, pain and deal size when you give all three (the answer says which method it used), otherwise scored on keywords in their names; a TAM/SAM/SOM calculation that uses only the company counts, deal size and percentages you give; a three-year expansion path and an ICP hypothesis for the chosen segment. It never chooses a segment you did not name: without segments it recommends none and explains how to find yours from your own customers.
- [Craft Message](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-craft-message/) (`impact_craft_message`): Takes your target customer, the key benefit and what sets you apart, and returns a positioning statement (full and one sentence), a message hierarchy from tagline to three supporting pillars, versions for different audiences, objection handling and ways to test the message. Optional product name, customer need, category, main competitor and business model fit it to your market. It writes from your own words, in whole sentences.
- [Translate Execution](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-translate-execution/) (`impact_translate_execution`): Takes a positioning statement, your target customer and the key benefit, and returns copy to edit for the channels you choose: a website hero, a LinkedIn tagline and post drafts, a three-email cold sequence, a sales deck outline and a 15-minute demo script, with calls to action that fit your business model and the order to work the channels in. Optional channels, product name and business model shape it.
- [IMPACT Full Audit](https://impact.gtmhelix.com/tools/impact-full-audit/) (`impact_full_audit`): Takes what your product does, your target customer and the problem you solve, and returns a positioning audit: an input completeness score for each IMPACT step, the proof you already have, your current positioning checked in words, a recommended positioning with tagline options, a 30-day action plan and the measures to track. Optional company name, differentiation, competitors, current positioning, customer feedback and business model make it fuller. The score measures how complete your inputs are, not how strong your positioning is.

## Questions and answers

### What is IMPACT?

IMPACT is a free web app and AI connector with eight positioning tools built on Shashwat Ghosh's IMPACT framework, for CMOs and marketing teams. Describe your product, buyers and rivals, and each tool returns a structured positioning draft with hypotheses to test, or a full audit. Add https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp in Claude or ChatGPT, no sign-in.

### Is IMPACT free, and do I need an account?

It is free, and there is no account or sign-in. Use the tools in your browser here, or add them to Claude or ChatGPT as a connector.

### Does it use AI to write the answers?

No. Each tool applies fixed rules in the IMPACT code to the inputs you give it. It does not call an AI model and does not look anything up. When you use it from Claude or another assistant, that assistant writes around the tool's answer.

### What happens to what I type?

It is sent to this site's server, used once to build the answer, and dropped when the answer is sent back. Nothing is stored and nothing you type is logged. The privacy page has the details.

### How do I use IMPACT in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, select + and then Add custom connector. Name it IMPACT, paste https://impact.gtmhelix.com/mcp and leave the sign-in fields empty. The page Use it in Claude or ChatGPT covers Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and Windsurf too.

### Who built it?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, founded in 2022 in Bengaluru. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology.

### Why do some answers look like templates?

Several tools return a structured plan with [placeholders] where your inputs did not give a fact. When an answer shows a benchmark, target, rate, weight or other figure you did not supply, it is labelled "Example figure: replace with your own". Figures calculated from your inputs are not labelled. Suggested lengths, timings and counts are marked as suggestions. Replace every example and placeholder before you use the result.

### Can I call the tools from my own code?

Yes. Send POST https://impact.gtmhelix.com/api/tools/<tool name> with a JSON body {"input": {...}}. The Docs page lists every field. Please keep to the rate limit of 30 requests per minute.

### Is the source code public?

Yes, at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/impact-mcp under the MIT licence. The npm package @shashwatgtmalpha/impact-mcp runs these tools locally; it can lag behind this site until a new version is published.

### Who is IMPACT not ideal for?

Teams that need buyer research done for them: IMPACT structures your positioning as hypotheses, and you test them with buyers. Anyone who needs live competitor data: the tools look nothing up; they work from what you type about your market and rivals, and anything they add themselves (such as common complaints in a category) is marked as something to check with buyers. Teams that need saved history: nothing is stored, so keep each draft where you keep your positioning work.

### How do I report a problem?

Email shashwat@gtmhelix.com or open an issue at https://github.com/shashwatgtm/impact-mcp/issues.
